name: Rozsály (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of red and green triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Rozsály (a crowned quartered red and blue shield with a stag, a church, a sun, a bunch of grapes and a tree) above the name ROZSÁLY in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: serrated border of red and green triangles
